Missing destinations render the frozen error, noredirect renders the frozen notice, unsafe, ambiguous, literal-owned, and self targets fail closed, and authored query and fragment components are preserved. The focused Framerail Node suite passed in this lane; central Rust execution remains outstanding.

The integration base already has the evidenced NewPage form, trusted Ajax dispatch, actor and site context checks, create permission, bounded format handling, collision failure, template lookup, and autosave modes. The focused Framerail Node suite passed in this lane; central Rust execution remains outstanding and no duplicate page-form action was added.

Deepwell no longer reconstructs a one-field javascript form from post-render HTML, invents an active-looking submission surface, or drops later fields. Rendering does not issue a token or call a mutation. Central Rust execution remains outstanding.
